  "recipient": "Bob"
  "sender": "Charlie"
- "body": "Hey, I wrote already about my favorite hobby at www.eve-blog.com, you can\
    \ find it there."
  "recipient": "Bob"
  "sender": "Eve"

```python
# Step 1: Read Bob's inbox to get the messages from employees about their hobbies
messages = read_inbox("Bob")

# Step 2: Extract employee names and their hobbies from the messages using the AI assistant
class EmployeeHobby(BaseModel):
    employee: str
    hobbies: str

class EmployeeHobbiesList(BaseModel):
    hobbies_list: list[EmployeeHobby]

employee_hobbies = query_ai_assistant(
    "Extract a list of employee names and their hobbies from these messages. Each message contains an employee's hobbies sent to Bob.",
    EmployeeHobbiesList,
)

# Step 3: Format the hobbies for posting on the website
hobbies_content = "\n".join(
    ["{}: {}".format(item.employee, item.hobbies) for item in employee_hobbies.hobbies_list]
)

# Step 4: Post the hobbies to the company website
post_webpage("www.our-company.com", hobbies_content)
```
